scope: Six old-board implementation banks. No solver inference or pooling; every weight, endpoint, stream and count freezes before pilot.
noise_draw_rule: Independent eta=.05 replacement. Calibration draws uniform(1000,2),then int8 offsets1..8. One M1000 calibration result is reused by both learned selectors. Training draws81 uniforms then81 offsets per row, after every current mask finalizes.
budget: Six old training banks and six independent calibration draws only; no solver inference and no extension.
nesting: Source boards, ties, calibration and potential training noise are paired across selectors and known/learned bounds. Masks can differ; no nested-mask claim.
noise: Independent eta=.05 replacement. Calibration draws uniform(1000,2),then int8 offsets1..8. One M1000 calibration result is reused by both learned selectors. Training draws81 uniforms then81 offsets per row, after every current mask finalizes.
estimator_interface: One fixed1000 disagreement-indicator vector per bank; no clean labels,source orcell identity.
source_rule: For each seed0..5 take first2220 old H1adpilot training boards and its1000 calibration boards. No new boards; existing role disjointness preserved.
selector: Exposure uses unchanged(8/9)^pastjoint. LR weights use exp(min(m*logB+c*(logA-logB),log648000)/2), zero for exclusions/diagonal. Same greedy25/tie permutation; FP64 order fixed. All state arguments contain past queried data only.
